ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic word شَجَرَةٌ (shajara) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. wind
   C. hot
   D. tree

2. How do you read the shadda in the word jad-dun? (1 mark)
   A. The vowel is long
   B. The word is a question
   C. The letter is silent
   D. The letter daal is said twice

3. What does the Arabic sentence لِي عَيْنَانِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two hands.
   B. My body is strong.
   C. This is my body.
   D. I have two eyes.

4. How many letters are in السبت (as-sabt) including alif and laam? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 3

5. How is the Arabic word جَدٌّ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jadd
   B. bint
   C. ʿamma
   D. ukht

6. What does the Arabic word تَحْتَ (taHta) mean? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. behind
   C. on
   D. beside

7. What does maadhaa mean? (1 mark)
   A. why
   B. what
   C. where
   D. who

8. What does the Arabic word اِسْمَعْ (ismaʿ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. write
   B. listen
   C. open the door
   D. read

9. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is hot.
   B. The weather is rainy.
   C. The weather is cloudy.
   D. The weather is cold.

10. What does the Arabic word خُضَارٌ (khudaar) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bananas
   B. bread
   C. vegetables
   D. fish

11. What is the name of the Arabic letter ز? (1 mark)
   A. alif
   B. miim
   C. zaay
   D. dhaal

12. What does the Arabic sentence مَنْ هَذَا؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. I have a brother and a sister.
   C. Who is this? (a boy or man)
   D. This is my mother.

13. What does the Arabic word بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) mean? (1 mark)
   A. eggs
   B. fish
   C. meat
   D. oranges

14. Which Arabic word means "cat"? (1 mark)
   A. قِطَّةٌ
   B. كُوبٌ
   C. طَاوِلَةٌ
   D. كِتَابٌ

15. How is the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-khamiis
   B. al-ithnayn
   C. usbuuʿ
   D. ath-thulaathaa'

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm? (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i (2 marks)

18. Write a short speech of at least four sentences about your house in Arabic sounds (English letters). Give the meaning. (5 marks) (5 marks)

19. Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'Today is Thursday.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kaʿka (2 marks)

21. Copy and translate the sentence أُحِبُّ الْخُبْزَ. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — tree
   شَجَرَةٌ (shajara) means tree.

2. D — The letter daal is said twice
   A shadda doubles the letter, so jadd has two d sounds.

3. D — I have two eyes.
   لِي عَيْنَانِ (lii ʿaynaani) means: I have two eyes.

4. C — 5
   The letters are alif, laam, siin, baa and taa.

5. A — jadd
   جَدٌّ is read jadd and means grandfather.

6. A — under
   تَحْتَ (taHta) means under.

7. B — what
   maadhaa means what.

8. B — listen
   اِسْمَعْ (ismaʿ) means listen.

9. A — The weather is hot.
   الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ (al-jawwu haarr) means: The weather is hot.

10. C — vegetables
   خُضَارٌ (khudaar) means vegetables.

11. C — zaay
   The letter ز is called zaay.

12. C — Who is this? (a boy or man)
   مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

13. D — oranges
   بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

14. A — قِطَّةٌ
   قِطَّةٌ (qitta) means cat.

15. D — ath-thulaathaa'
   الثُّلَاثَاءُ is read ath-thulaathaa' and means Tuesday.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: How is the weather today?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: And the rain is from the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. ismii Amina. haadhaa baytii. fii baytii matbakh. shukran li-istimaaʿikum. (Peace be upon you. My name is Amina. This is my house. In my house there is a kitchen. Thank you for listening.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the topic sentence, 1 mark for a detail and 1 mark for the closing thanks.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis. Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: On the table there is a cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: uhibbu l-khubza. I like bread.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct copy or sounds and 1 mark for the translation.
